# Security and failure-handling Checklist: Private file storage

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for signed addresses, failure handling and the module's contract
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated by `/speckit-auto` (2026-10-04), which drives checklists to zero open items: each `[x]` names the text that satisfies it; the items that failed on first reading were fixed in spec.md first.

## Signed addresses

- [x] CHK001 Is every signed address's lifetime stated as a number? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006] — 15, 5, 60 minutes.
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified which properties an upload address binds (key, type, size)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is the relation between the declared size and the purpose's limit in the signed form specified? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — the form's limit is the declared size.
- [x] CHK004 Is it stated that a download address is valid for one key only, on the provider's domain? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, US2 scenario 4]
- [x] CHK005 Is the public-image lifetime consistent with the bucket staying private? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, US2 scenario 3] — public images still go through signed addresses.

## Trust boundaries and keys

- [x] CHK006 Is it stated who decides access, and that storage never does? [Completeness, Spec intro, Plan §V]
- [x] CHK007 Is the owner id's allowed form quantified, so a key cannot leave its prefix? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases] — fixed: "1 to 64 letters, digits, `_` or `-`".
- [x] CHK008 Is it defined what happens when a caller confirms a key that is not its own `incoming/` key? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated that keys carry no file name or personal data, for both incoming and final keys? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK010 Is the check-then-move window addressed (the upload address is still valid while confirm runs)? [Gap → Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases] — fixed: only the checked object is moved.
- [x] CHK011 Are secrets' handling requirements stated (never echoed, never sent to the browser)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Refusals and failures

- [x] CHK012 Are status and code enumerated for every refusal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005] — fixed: malformed size, purpose or owner id now name 400 `validation_failed`.
- [x] CHK013 Is the behaviour defined when the store is down during each operation (signing, upload, confirm, delete, server write, readiness)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009] — fixed: confirm, delete and write added.
- [x] CHK014 Is the helper's retry policy quantified, and its conflict with the brief's queue wording resolved and recorded? [Clarity/Conflict, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications Q2]
- [x] CHK015 Is the readiness timing measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Is deleting a missing key defined as success? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]

## Dependencies and assumptions

- [x] CHK017 Are bucket settings that live outside the code (privacy, versioning, life-cycle, CORS, separate keys) listed with an owner? [Dependency, Plan §Outside the code]
- [x] CHK018 Is the open provider decision recorded rather than assumed? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK019 Is it stated what the inline content of a served file can be, so a stored file cannot run script under MotorFix's domain? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006] — only image and PDF types, served from the provider's domain.

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
